integrity: The proof was reconstructed from the source multiplier, scaled-primal-residual, feasibility, complementarity, and subsequence estimates. The strict enlargement is witnessed by an explicit positive growth sequence with unbounded successive ratios.
scientific_limitations: The result weakens the growth assumptions sufficient for the published finite-epsilon-KKT proof. It does not claim necessity for algorithmic convergence or numerical superiority of bursty penalties.
title: Proof-exact growth conditions for bursty penalty schedules in proximal augmented Lagrangian methods
